<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Shiv Sena leadership dispute:</strong> The Eknath Shinde-led faction has informed the Supreme Court that the 2018 amendment to the Shiv Sena constitution effectively consolidated power under the party chief.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>BJP outreach initiative:</strong> The BJP has announced a month-long &#x27;Seva Sankalp Abhiyan&#x27; to commemorate Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s 25 years of public service.</li>
  <li><strong>Punjab political realignments:</strong> Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann stated that any potential revival of the BJP-Akali Dal alliance remains contingent upon the status of farm laws.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
</ul>
